folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B391: actual probe scope and causal comic contracts
folds.body:
All50 CL/CK/CA rows, every F/S/N/P finding and both probe descriptions were read. Synthetic workloads and predicted “fail” labels are requirements analysis, not executed timing/gameplay tests. M1/M2 establish only their specified schema rejection, model byte count and selected arithmetic results. JSON rendering a non-finite result as null does not make it admissible native save state. A5percent damage floor cannot express a source-authored unreachable body, and a1e308 numeric overflow is different from ordinary finite tier handling. Reach/contact/penetration/authority/counter/collateral semantics precede a choice of numeric magnitude; no universal combat abstraction or ceiling is adopted.

Preserve the concrete causal contracts across the50 rows: instance namespace reaches people/bodies/gear/claims/jobs/knowledge/RNG, not just a site ID; a counterpart link is not an instance-parent link or name match; a life flag is not revival custody/controller/estate reconciliation. Actor-local title grants do not establish an exclusive/shared office, vacancy, claimants or former-holder history. Sponsor audience, attention allocation, reputation and spendable payment have different owners; repeated tie-ins are not automatically new viewers or six rewards. One cross-world event needs its chosen owner/phase/acknowledgments and recoverable assets, not several unrelated local occurrences.

True-in-world date, recorded/revised date and a witness's learned-at/belief version are distinct. A retcon needs selected dependency/grandfather/refund/recompute semantics before invalidating work or granting a payout. A lossy biography, evicted DOM rows or bounded latest knowledge cannot reconstruct that history. Recaps, stable ordinary records and accessible interfaces need not require a supernatural cheat; unseen minds/identities still require actual means. UI skin/caption/SFX does not change physical material, load support or target law without an actual command. Game elapsed time, beat order and reading pace remain separate.

A512-boundary call stop is not512actors or an erroneous partial result; retained unspent time must be resumed under actual choice/event barriers. Abstract-to-detailed promotion must retain known stock, obligations and prior consequences. Old active/absent K-lane statements, source counts, clock assumptions and source-level gaps are dated. Current [PROJECT](../../PROJECT.md), AD39/44/51/52 govern build order and supported abstraction, with AD42 keeping human taste optional. No comic canon, private truth, current engine, imported save, browser or stress workload was newly verified or launched.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B391: distinct peer policies and current project direction
folds.body:
The full333-line survey, all19 profiles/seven dimensions, nine lessons and eight proposed additions were read. Source/edition and route matter: an API declaration is not executable Melvor runtime, a mod scheduler description is not a current vanilla implementation, an identified mirror is not the official current release, and developer performance reports are not this lane's measurements. Unknown closed-engine cells stay unknown rather than acquiring common folklore. Original/sequel, browser/mobile and fork/live-release distinctions remain explicit.

Keep the peer mechanisms distinct. Bounded/coarser replay, threshold-qualified subsystem formulas, a bank spent through faster future play, offscreen in-game map actualization and callback-dependent freeze do different work. Worker timing can still run simulation/DOM on the page thread. In-game absence is not wall-clock closed-app reward, and accelerated client installation is not catch-up. No foreign tick/cap/rate/skip method changes OOPS clock policy. Current AD52 requires real means, workers/support, costs, events and retained choices for compression, while current bank/absence owners qualify the old parked-bank recommendation. Neither a current income snapshot nor a higherdt proves consequential equivalence.

Save codec/version markers, gameplay migration, RNG cursor/order, native actor reconstruction and observable future continuation are different. A seed field or equal current totals does not prove the same next outcomes. Numeric range, smallest meaningful delta and exact conserved money/stock/XP need their own domain contract; a larger-magnitude number or display format is not universal precision. Relevance indexes, stable nonurgent phase distribution and caches can reduce work without changing hard due order. Coarse actors/stock/promise history must materialize without convenient rerolls, identity reassignment or duplication.

Useful retained lessons are committed view batching/listener teardown, restore dependency order before observations, selected continuation fingerprints, bounded catch-up presentation with causal receipts, and scan-versus-index equivalence. Several visible desktop panels remain independent; none requires importing a single-tab/global-reactivity host. Post-load caches do not grant rewards, draws or time. Exact/statistical/intentionally different adapters declare their actual boundary instead of calling all fast-forward equivalent. Current [PROJECT](../../PROJECT.md) retires the one-realm milestone and keeps Electron/web, LOTM-first/HP-alongside; AD42/51 qualify old human and foundation gates. No source game, license, current API, package, runtime, new policy or benchmark was fetched/executed here.
